thesis: Fastest to connect, hardest to get paid: no capacity payment and a merchant index down about 85% in two years. The model loses money even with a toll, so only an executed toll at a known price makes a case.
并网最快，回款最难：没有容量付费，市场化指数两年内下跌约85%。即便有租赁，模型仍然亏损，因此只有价格明确的已签署租赁才能成立。

reason: Last of fourteen markets on hold IRR, −5.9%.

reason: Real-time co-optimisation changed how energy and ancillary services clear, and data-centre interconnections have been paused for audit since August 2026; nothing here is contracted with the market, so there is no contract for a rule change to honour or break.
实时联合优化改变了电能量与辅助服务的出清方式；数据中心并网自2026年8月起因审计而暂停。此处没有与市场签订的合同，因此也谈不上规则变更是否追溯存量合同。

reason: The fleet reached about 15 GW in early 2026, and the published fleet revenue index fell from USD 193 per kW in 2023 to USD 56 in 2024 and about USD 29 in 2025.
